correctness.rationale: Let Y_t be number absent, start Y_0=0. Inclusion-expansion over selected coupon types gives exact return probability u_t=sum_{j=0}^m binom(m,j)q^(m-j)p^j(1-j/m)^t and Green function R(z)=sum_j w_j/(1-z(1-j/m)). Full-state holding rounds are geometric(p), and entrance-to-entrance generating function obeys R(z)=1/((1-qz)(1-F(z))). Laurent expansion R(z)=q^m/(1-z)+m sum_{j>=1}w_j/j +O(1-z) gives mean 1/(p q^m) and exact squared CV (2-p)q^m+2mp sum_j w_j/j -1. Under p=c/m the bounded binomial reciprocal converges to Poisson expectation, giving V(c)=2e^-c(1+cA(c))-1 where A(c)=sum c^j/(j j!). Its derivative has sign g(c)=-1+2c-sum_{j>=2} c^j/(j(j-1)j!), with g strictly concave, g(0)=-1,g(1)=e-2>0,g(infinity)<0. Therefore exactly two positive g roots, global min and max, and endpoint expansions V=1-2c+O(c²) as c down 0 and V=1+2/c+O(c^-2) as c tends infinity force exactly one V=1 crossing on rising branch. Independent exact one-coupon renewal computations agree, and inspected source checker independently solves finite rational hitting-time systems; numeric root brackets are illustrative. Renewal counting Fano limit takes time first, system size second.
